facts.text: PQSC is the QCoDeS driver class for the Zurich Instruments PQSC
run() starts sending out triggers and activates trigger generation over the ZSync ports

arm() configures the execution engine and clears the register bank; repetitions and holdoff optionally set the number of triggers and the time between repeated triggers, and the hold-off has a minimum value and a granularity of 100 ns
arm_and_run() combines arm and run and synchronizes between the device and the data server after arming and running

stop() is documented to stop the trigger generation; deep (default True) performs a synchronization between the device and the data server after the disable, and the call forwards to the toolkit object
A deep operation on a node blocks until the device has acknowledged it and returns the acknowledged value
wait_done() waits until trigger generation and feedback processing is done, bounded by timeout in seconds, and raises TimeoutError when the sequence is not done before it
check_ref_clock() checks whether the reference clock is locked successfully, bounded by timeout in seconds
get_idn() returns the vendor, model, serial and firmware of the connected device
factory_reset() loads the factory default settings
get_streamingnodes() returns the streaming nodes available on the device
set_transaction() returns the toolkit transaction context manager that bundles node set commands; it is not a value setter
serial and device_type are properties of the instrument
the device-creator PQSC constructor creates a ZISession for host and port and connects the serial with connect_device(serial, interface=interface)

operator_required.reason: no source states a wait_done timeout bound; the deployment sets the maximum wait for its trigger sequence

safe_state.description: trigger generation stopped by the native PQSC stop(deep=True), documented to synchronize the device and the data server after the disable (the implementation is zhinst-toolkit's, outside the clone); the device settings and the connected instruments are not reset, so their configuration and any sequence they run on their own are left as they were
